title: NBA: 76ers rally to stun Cavs in James's first home game for Philadelphia
summary: The Philadelphia 76ers erased a 29-point deficit to stun the Cleveland Cavaliers, 114-106, on Thursday in NBA superstar LeBron James's first home game since landing in Philly as a free agent.
